text:
I live in Toronto now and don't use Hydro Ottawa. But I think their billing practices are alarming and want to warn other consumers.
I used to live in an apartment downtown for a year. I moved in with my parents to do a masters, cancelled my account. Paid off everything and formally closed it. But for more than a year, it kept taking money from a different account of mine. At random times. I called their customer service many times. Sent them proof of withdrawals. They would say no, my account is closed. No debits are happening.
But when my parents and I went through our bills, it turned out that they had linked my banking info to my parents' billing number, because I told them I was moving in with my parents. But my parents didn't notice because they always get refunds of overpayments. So they thought it was normal. After many hours on the phone, multiple reps, and finally a manager actually investigated. Confirmed the mistake and fixed it. But they refused to refund at first. Just apologized.
I don't give my banking details to them for auto-debit again. Their approach with our data is just reckless. It should worry everyone.
